svg.title: Stretch time, then trade it for pitch
svg.desc: Three waveforms share one time scale. An original tone occupies duration T. WSOLA doubles its duration, keeping wave spacing unchanged. Resampling at twice the rate restores duration T and doubles the frequency. Colored source regions show the order of reused material schematically.

g.text: Stretch time, then trade it for pitch
An octave up, with the original duration. All three rows use the same time scale.
half the cycle length → twice the pitch
Colors track source regions, not individual WSOLA windows.
Schematic tone. Local search and overlap fades are omitted here.
